info.title: Instant Snap API
info.description: Capture a web page on demand: an image, a video, a PDF or the page's readable text as markdown, returned in the response, as a download link, or uploaded to your own bucket.

post.description: Runs the capture inside the request: the capture itself gets at most 100 seconds, and every answer is sent within 120. Set client timeouts above 120 seconds. Only successful captures are charged; a capture that could not be stored and answered within the 120 seconds ends as `capture_timeout` and is not charged. With `async: true` it is not waited on: the answer is `202 Accepted` at once and the capture runs with up to `timeout` seconds (30-300, default 120).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry. A second request with the same key within 24 hours does not capture again: it gets the first capture back (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`), `idempotency_key_in_use` while the first is still running, or `idempotency_key_reused` if the body differs or the first was `by_format` (whose file is not kept). A replayed `async` capture is answered `202 Accepted` with its `Location`, as the first request was, whatever state it is in now; one that never ran (`capture_busy`, `service_unavailable`, `queue_full`, `capture_expired`) releases the key, so the retry runs.

200.description: `json` and `cloud_storage`: the capture. `by_format`: the file itself, with its metadata in `X-InstantSnap-*` headers - for a content capture, the text, as `text/markdown; charset=utf-8` or `text/plain; charset=utf-8`.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this answer is a replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

X-InstantSnap-Final-Url.description: Absent when the URL is not plain ASCII.

X-InstantSnap-Sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of the body.

X-InstantSnap-Part-Count.description: Only when the answer has more than one part.

202.description: `async: true`: accepted, not captured yet. The capture as it is now - `status` `queued` (or already `running`). Read it again at `Location`, or wait for `callback_url`.

400.description: The request was not valid. Codes: `validation_failed`, `s3_destination_invalid`.

401.description: The key is missing, malformed, revoked or for the other product. Codes: `api_key_invalid`.

402.description: The plan has no captures (or storage) left. Codes: `quota_exhausted`.

403.description: The plan does not include this. Codes: `feature_not_available`, `no_trigger_allowance`.

413.description: The file is larger than 64 MB, the most `by_format` returns, or a content capture's text is larger than 2 MB. Codes: `payload_too_large`.

429.description: Too many requests, or your organization already has 100 async captures waiting. Codes: `rate_limited`, `queue_full`.

500.description: Our side failed after the capture ran. Codes: `internal_error`.

502.description: The website could not be captured. Codes: `capture_failed`.

503.description: No capture slot (every browser is busy, or your organization already has its share of captures running), or a service is down, including no outbound proxy being available; nothing is charged, retry after the hint. Codes: `capture_busy`, `service_unavailable`.

504.description: The page did not finish in time, or the capture could not be stored and answered within the 120-second budget; not charged either way. Codes: `capture_timeout`.

404.description: No such capture for this account. Codes: `capture_not_found`.

429.description: Too many requests. Reading a capture back has a window of its own, 300 requests a minute per source - five times the captures' - so polling an async capture does not spend the window captures use. Codes: `rate_limited`.

get.description: No key needed. Cached for a day.

503.description: The proxy pool could not be reached. Codes: `service_unavailable`.

get.description: Every webhook endpoint of the key's organization, whoever added it. Takes an Instant Snap key; the same list is managed with an Auto Schedule key at /auto-schedule/v1/webhook-endpoints.

503.description: A service is down; retry after the hint. Codes: `service_unavailable`.

post.description: Adds an endpoint to the organization, for an integration that registers its own webhook (n8n, Zapier, Make). It gets a signing secret of its own, returned only in this answer. An organization can have 25 endpoints. Takes an Instant Snap key; the same list is managed with an Auto Schedule key at /auto-schedule/v1/webhook-endpoints.

400.description: The URL cannot receive webhooks, or an event or product is not known. Codes: `validation_failed`.

409.description: The organization already has 25 endpoints. Codes: `webhook_endpoint_limit_reached`.

403.description: The plan has no webhooks (the free trial). Codes: `feature_not_available`.

503.description: A service is down; retry after the hint. Codes: `service_unavailable`.

404.description: No such endpoint in the key's organization. Codes: `webhook_endpoint_not_found`.

503.description: A service is down; retry after the hint. Codes: `service_unavailable`.

delete.description: Nothing more is posted to it. Deliveries already in the log stay there.

404.description: No such endpoint in the key's organization. Codes: `webhook_endpoint_not_found`.

503.description: A service is down; retry after the hint. Codes: `service_unavailable`.

get.description: The name you gave this Instant Snap key, its public prefix, its product and the email of the member who created it. Integrations show it to tell one connected account from another (Zapier's connection label), and you can call it to check a key without spending a capture. Never returns the key itself and counts towards no allowance. An Auto Schedule key answers the same at /auto-schedule/v1/account.

503.description: A service is down; retry after the hint. Codes: `service_unavailable`.

get.summary: A render link: a signed URL that is itself a screenshot
get.description: For an `` tag, an email or a social preview, which cannot send `X-Api-Key`: the link carries a signature made with the key's render secret, so nobody can change the page or the options in it. Sign links on your server; never put the render secret in a page. A view answers with the capture of this exact link while it is younger than `ttl` (free, `X-InstantSnap-Render: stored`); otherwise it makes one ordinary capture (`captured`), counted like any other. When there is nothing to show yet it answers `200` with a small placeholder image instead, cached for seconds: `preparing` (a capture is running or could not start; 10 s), `limit_reached` (no captures left; 60 s) or `failed` (the page could not be captured; 60 s). At most 60 new captures a minute go through render links per organization; past that, views get `preparing`. Only the options listed here exist; headers, cookies, S3 delivery, callbacks and async have no render-link form. Included in the Pro, Business and Business Plus plans.

parameters.name: key_prefix
parameters.description: The 12 characters after `wsw_api_` in the Instant Snap key whose render secret signs the link. Render links must be turned on for that key (dashboard, API Keys, Render links).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The image format.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The page to capture. Absolute http or https, no credentials in the URL.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Seconds a capture of this link is served, to every view, before a view captures again. Also the `Cache-Control` max-age.

parameters.name: thumb_width
parameters.description: Shrink the image to this width after the capture, keeping its proportions.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels.

parameters.name: device_scale_factor
parameters.description: Device pixel ratio.

parameters.name: emulated_device
parameters.description: A device from the catalog, case-insensitive. Defaults to "iPhone 13" when `device_category` is mobile.

parameters.name: scroll_mode
parameters.description: `scroll` captures the full page. Video defaults to `scroll`.

parameters.name: max_height
parameters.description: Refused, not lowered, above the format ceiling (WebP 16383 ÷ scale factor, JPEG 65500).

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Percent. Applied to a desktop video only (`media_category` `video` without an emulated device); any other value than 100 on another capture is refused with `validation_failed`.

parameters.name: press_escape
parameters.description: Press the Escape key after the pop-up pass and again after scrolling (once in a video), for a modal that closes on Escape.

parameters.name: scrolling_delay_ms
parameters.description: How long to pause after each scroll step of a full-page capture. Ignored for a viewport capture.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: BCP 47.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA time zone.

parameters.name: hide
parameters.description: Up to 25 comma-separated CSS selectors (an XPath starting with // works too) of elements to hide before capturing. Each is applied on its own; one the browser rejects is skipped.

parameters.name: xpath
parameters.description: Capture only the element this XPath selects.

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: CSS selector of an element to click before capturing.

parameters.name: hover
parameters.description: CSS selector of an element to hover before capturing.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: A country from `GET /instant-snap/v1/catalog` `proxy_countries`. Requires the ProxyLocation plan feature. Without this block the capture still goes out through a proxy, in the default location.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: Lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the whole render secret (`wsw_rsk_…`), of the canonical string: `/instant-snap/v1/render/{key_prefix}/{format}?` followed by every other parameter as `name=value`, names and values percent-encoded per RFC 3986 (everything but `A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~`, upper-case hex), sorted by encoded name and joined with `&`. Booleans are `true`/`false`, numbers in their shortest form. Every client library builds links (`RenderLink`), and render-link-vectors.json in the spec repository has examples to test against. Put it last in the link.

200.description: The image - the capture, or a placeholder (see `X-InstantSnap-Render`).

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=<seconds>`: what remains of `ttl` for a capture, or the placeholder's few seconds.

400.description: The link is not one: an unknown or repeated option, a value out of range, an option the capture refuses. Codes: `validation_failed`.

401.description: The signature does not match, or the key is unknown, revoked or has render links turned off. Codes: `api_key_invalid`.

403.description: The plan does not include render links. Codes: `feature_not_available`.

CaptureRequest.description: Every field except `url` is optional. A field that is not sent takes its default; `false` is a value, not "not sent".

url.description: The page to capture. Absolute http or https, no credentials in the URL.

response_type.description: `json` answers with metadata and a download link; `by_format` answers with the file itself; `cloud_storage` uploads to your bucket.

media_category.description: `content` returns the page's readable main content as text instead of a picture: navigation, footers, cookie banners and scripts are left out. Charged like an image. Sending a content `format` without `media_category` is enough.

format.description: Must belong to `media_category`. image: png, jpeg, webp, tiff. video: mp4, webm, mov, gif. pdf: image_pdf, document_pdf. content: markdown (the default), text. A content capture returns at most 2 MB of UTF-8 (`limits.content_max_bytes` in the defaults) and does not take `page_source`, `timestamp_watermark`, `auto_height`, `max_height`, `selectors.xpath`, `selectors.hide` or `selectors.hover`.

emulated_device.description: A device from the catalog, case-insensitive. Defaults to "iPhone 13" when `device_category` is mobile.

scroll_mode.description: `scroll` captures the full page. Video defaults to `scroll`.

max_height.description: Refused, not lowered, above the format ceiling (WebP 16383 ÷ scale factor, JPEG 65500).

zoom.description: Percent. Applied to a desktop video only (`media_category` `video` without an emulated device); any other value than 100 on another capture is refused with `validation_failed`.

press_escape.description: Press the Escape key after the pop-up pass and again after scrolling (once in a video), for a modal that closes on Escape.

scrolling_delay_ms.description: How long to pause after each scroll step of a full-page capture. Ignored for a viewport capture.

headers.description: Sent with every request the page makes. Names are sent exactly as given. Requires the RequestHeadersCookies plan feature.

cookies.description: Set for the URL's origin. Names are sent exactly as given. Requires the RequestHeadersCookies plan feature.

geolocation.description: Latitude and longitude are sent together or not at all.

xpath.description: Capture only the element this XPath selects.

hide.description: Up to 25 comma-separated CSS selectors (an XPath starting with // works too) of elements to hide before capturing. Each is applied on its own; one the browser rejects is skipped.

click.description: CSS selector of an element to click before capturing.

hover.description: CSS selector of an element to hover before capturing.

country.description: A country from `GET /instant-snap/v1/catalog` `proxy_countries`. Requires the ProxyLocation plan feature. Without this block the capture still goes out through a proxy, in the default location.

timestamp_watermark.description: A strip with the capture time and URL. Sending the block turns it on. Not available for video.

page_source.description: Also keep the page source. Charged as a second capture, capped at 10 MB, not available with `by_format`.

s3_delivery.description: Where `cloud_storage` uploads the file. Required for `cloud_storage` and refused for the other response types. Needs `region` or `endpoint_url`.

endpoint_url.description: https only, and not a private address.

wait_for_sync.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for the upload before answering, but never past the 95-second answer limit; when the time runs out the status is `in_progress`.

callback_url.description: Also receives the capture.succeeded or capture.failed webhook, and delivery.completed when a `cloud_storage` upload has finished or finally failed. A capture refused before it ran and answered in the response (`capture_busy`, `service_unavailable`, `queue_full`) sends no webhook: the response is the answer. Requires the Webhooks plan feature.

async.description: Do not wait: answered `202 Accepted` at once with the capture (`status` `queued`) and a `Location` header, then run when a browser is free. Read it with GET /instant-snap/v1/captures/{id} or receive it at `callback_url`. Only with `response_type` `json` or `cloud_storage`. One still waiting after 15 minutes ends as `capture_expired`, not charged.

timeout.description: Async only: the seconds the capture may take in the browser, every attempt included. Time in the queue does not count. Refused without `async`.

url.description: The page the capture was asked for, as the request's `url` was stored. `final_url` says where the browser ended up.

status.description: `delivered` is the end state of a `by_format` capture: the file went back in the response and is not kept. An async capture reads `queued` until a browser takes it and `running` while it is captured.

page_http_status.description: The status the website answered with.

captured_at.description: When the page was captured. UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds (`2026-09-26T10:30:00.000Z`).

final_url.description: Where the browser ended up, when the page redirected.

media_sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of the file.

download_url.description: Valid for 60 minutes and reissued on every read. Null for `by_format` and `cloud_storage`.

expires_at.description: When the file is deleted (24 hours after capture). UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds (`2026-09-26T10:30:00.000Z`).

access_key_id.description: Masked to its last four characters.

error_code.description: Why a `failed` or `timed_out` capture ended; one of the error tokens. An async capture that never ran ends `failed` with `capture_expired`.

spec_version.description: The default set the capture was taken under.

Defaults.description: The values a capture takes for fields it does not send, and the limits it is checked against. Versioned by `spec_version`.

error_code.description: A stable, lowercase token. Switch on this, never on the HTTP status or the message.

error_message.description: One sentence for a person. The wording can change between releases.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Set on rate_limited, queue_full, capture_busy, service_unavailable and idempotency_key_in_use; mirrors the Retry-After header.

WebhookEndpoint.description: A webhook endpoint of the key's organization. The same list the app shows under Developer Tools, Webhooks. Never carries a secret.

product.description: Limited to one product's events; null for both.

web_page_id.description: Limited to one schedule's events; null for every schedule.

is_enabled.description: False once the endpoint was switched off, by its owner or after 20 failed deliveries in a row.

has_own_secret.description: True when deliveries are signed with this endpoint's own secret (created through this API); false when they are signed with the organization's secret (added in the app).

WebhookEndpointItem.description: A webhook endpoint of the key's organization. The same list the app shows under Developer Tools, Webhooks. Never carries a secret.

product.description: Limited to one product's events; null for both.

web_page_id.description: Limited to one schedule's events; null for every schedule.

is_enabled.description: False once the endpoint was switched off, by its owner or after 20 failed deliveries in a row.

has_own_secret.description: True when deliveries are signed with this endpoint's own secret (created through this API); false when they are signed with the organization's secret (added in the app).

url.description: Where to post: a public https address.

name.description: What the endpoint is called in the app. Default: "Added through the API".

product.description: Take only this product's events. Leave out for both.

signing_secret.description: The secret deliveries to this endpoint are signed with (X-WSW-Signature). Returned only here: store it now. Starts with whsec_.

key_name.description: The name you gave the key under Developer Tools, API Keys.

key_prefix.description: The key's public prefix, as the app shows it beside the name. Not enough to use the key.

product.description: The product the key belongs to.

email.description: The member who created the key; null when they are no longer a member.
